name: Tatakai Extension Server
description: Owner-managed source extensions, built-in media proxy, and a connection URL for Tatakai.

SERVER_SECRET.description: Persistent encryption key. Keep it across redeployments.

BOOTSTRAP_SECRET.description: Initial owner setup key. Copy from Heroku Config Vars into setup.

PUBLIC_URL.description: Your public HTTPS app origin, e.g. https://YOUR-APP.herokuapp.com

PGSSLMODE.description: Heroku Postgres encrypted connection using its documented certificate mode.
